summary: Zenta Group, a Macau-based Nasdaq-listed professional services provider, filed a Form 6-K reporting results of an extraordinary general meeting held September 30, 2026, where shareholders approved a 12-to-1 share consolidation, authorized a contingent 20-to-1 consolidation if the share price stays below US$1.00 for eight consecutive trading days, and adopted amended articles. The filing is a routine post-meeting notice covering governance mechanics, not a special situation. The consolidation, intended to restore compliance with Nasdaq's minimum bid price rule, will reduce authorized capital to roughly 83.3 million Class A and 1.67 million Class B shares, with fractional shares rounded up. Watch for the market-effective date and any subsequent minimum-bid deficiency notice if the price fails to recover above US$1.00.
